title: Transfer - Molecular Lattice OBJ Export
goal: Export a Three.js molecular lattice made from atom spheres and bond cylinders, including instanced atoms across the crystal cell, into /root/output/lattice.obj with coordinates preserved after Blender-axis conversion.
skillBenefitRationale: This moves the exporter skill into scientific visualization, but the only essential capability remains converting a generated Three.js mesh hierarchy into a correct OBJ artifact.
